title: How a Puffin Keeps Fishing With 62 Fish Already in Its Beak
subject: Atlantic puffin

scenes.text: How does a puffin keep catching fish with its beak already full?
A puffin can dive about 40 meters and stay under for up to a minute.
In Britain, one was recorded holding 62 fish at once.
Most carry between 5 and 20 fish on a trip back to the chick.
The trick is its tongue. The tip is rough, and spines on the roof of its mouth help hold fish.
It presses each new fish against those spines, so the ones it already holds don't drop.

description:
A puffin can keep catching fish with its beak already full.
The record in Britain is 62 fish at once. A rough tongue tip and a row of spines on the roof of its mouth hold the catch while it hunts for more.
How many fish do you think you could carry?
first_comment: People think the fish are lined up head to tail, but that's a myth. Have you ever seen a puffin in person?
